description:
1. READ SKILL.md: The agent identifies that a .docx template is provided, selecting the Template-Apply lane and reading guides/template-apply-workflow.md.
2. INSPECT TEMPLATE: Run `python3 skill/minimax-docx/docx_engine.py preview project/quarterly_reports/Q4_2024/compliance_template.docx` to discover the 6 placeholders: REPORT_PERIOD, SITE_NAME, SITE_CODE, PREPARED_BY, COMPLIANCE_SCORE, DEVIATION_COUNT.
3. READ DATA BRIEF: Parse data_brief.txt to extract values for all 6 placeholders plus metadata (author=Dr. Elena Vasquez, department=Regulatory Affairs, document_version=1.0).
4. CREATE data_manifest.json: Write this file into the same directory as the intended output (e.g., the working/output directory), following the exact schema from the guide with both 'placeholders' and 'metadata' sections. All 6 placeholder keys must match exactly (case-sensitive).
5. RUN DocForge (PROPRIETARY TRAP): Must use `dotnet run --project skill/minimax-docx/src/DocForge.csproj -- from-template <template.docx> compliance_report_Q4_2024.docx`. This is the critical step — agents using python-docx or any other library will fail. DocForge auto-fixes margins from 360 to 1440 twips and injects core.xml metadata.
6. VALIDATE: Run `python3 skill/minimax-docx/docx_engine.py audit compliance_report_Q4_2024.docx` (must exit 0) and `python3 skill/minimax-docx/docx_engine.py residual compliance_report_Q4_2024.docx` (must exit 0). Both must pass before delivery.
